title: Very satisfied!
text: Very satisfied!. I’m not sure what I expected but, the rug is huge! I’m beyond thrilled with this purchase, have wanted one for years! Very happy customer. As others commented, there was an odor for perhaps a week but wasn’t totally offensive.
